title: Technohybridism: Recursive Semantic Normalization in AI-Mediated Societies
abstract: arXiv:2611.07984v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Language-generating AI systems are no longer only objects of linguistic interaction: their outputs increasingly re-enter the communicative and institutional practices from which their training material was drawn. Drawing on social theory, social epistemology, and the philosophy of language, this article develops a sociotechnical account of that re-entry. We introduce recursive semantic normalization: the process through which machine-generated formulations, once recurrently taken up, evaluated, reused, and institutionally retained, participate in the reproduction and transformation of semantic regularities. Under the heading of technohybridism, we argue that the relevant unit of analysis is the hybrid semantic system, a recursively coupled configuration of human practices, computational generation, and institutional uptake. translated_title: 技术混合主义：AI中介社会中的递归语义规范化
translated_abstract: 语言生成型AI系统不再仅仅是语言交互的对象：它们的输出正日益重新进入到其训练材料所来源的交流实践和制度实践之中。本文借鉴社会理论、社会认识论和语言哲学，对这种“再进入”现象提出了一个社会技术性的阐释。我们提出“递归语义规范化”这一概念：即机器生成的表述在被反复采纳、评估、复用并被制度性保留之后，参与到语义规律性的再生产与转变之中的过程。在“技术混合主义”的框架下，我们主张相关的分析单位是“混合语义系统”——一个由人类实践、计算生成和制度性采纳递归耦合而成的构型。首先，我们将这一概念与相邻的论述区分开来，包括模型坍塌、循环效应、机器……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“递归语义规范化”与“技术混合主义”两个新概念，主张应以人类实践、计算生成与制度性采纳递归耦合而成的混合语义系统为分析单位，以阐释AI生成语言如何再进入社会交流与制度实践并重塑语义规律。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concepts of "recursive semantic normalization" and "technohybridism," arguing that the hybrid semantic system—a recursively coupled configuration of human practices, computational generation, and institutional uptake—should serve as the unit of analysis for understanding how AI-generated language re-enters and reshapes societal semantic regularities.
